[(F1 score of the model with MTL, entity labeling, and relation extraction tasks) - F1 score of the baseline model] / F1 score of the baseline model * 100%

In this case, the improvement percentage would be:

[(0.56 - 0.49) / 0.49] * 100% = 12.25%
